sentences.text: Cooper, a 6-year-old neutered male Labrador Retriever, is on day 46 of 56 of an owner-entered Royal Canin HP trial since May 18, with chicken on 29 of 154 meals and treats: Dentastix (label lists chicken) daily from Jun 8 on the owner-entered allowed list, and at least 4 off-list feedings, the last Jun 27.

Itching is recorded on 16 of 43 logged days over at least 35 days; this is not a test of the diet, with Apoquel 16 mg once daily (doses not logged), NexGard from Jun 5 and Dentastix from Jun 8 all overlapping the trial.
The NexGard 68 mg chew, given Jun 5 and Jul 2, has flavour protein unknown and is not counted off-list.
